name: CISplatin + Pemetrexed (+/- Bevacizumab) for malignant pleural mesothelioma

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic cisplatin plus pemetrexed backbone is NOT biomarker-gated. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Malignant Pleural Mesothelioma v3.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (cisplatin or carboplatin / pemetrexed +/- bevacizumab).

histology: malignant pleural mesothelioma (epithelioid, biphasic, or sarcomatoid)

premedications.name: Folic acid
premedications.notes: low-dose folic acid supplementation started before and continued through pemetrexed therapy (Harrison line 82142).

premedications.name: Vitamin B12
premedications.notes: vitamin B12 supplementation with pemetrexed to reduce toxicity (Harrison line 82142).

premedications.name: Dexamethasone
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication for pemetrexed skin-rash prophylaxis (standard supportive care).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (highly emetogenic)
premedications.notes: cisplatin-based doublet is highly emetogenic; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: Pemetrexed requires folic acid + vitamin B12 supplementation (Harrison line 82142) and dexamethasone rash prophylaxis.
cisplatin: IV hydration and nephro-/oto-/neurotoxicity monitoring (magnesium repletion).
Bevacizumab (if used): monitor blood pressure, proteinuria, and bleeding/thrombosis risk.
Carboplatin (AUC-dosed) is a source-listed alternative platinum for patients unfit for cisplatin (guideline line 774).
monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) and magnesium before each cisplatin cycle
blood pressure and urine protein (if bevacizumab)

doseModificationRules.condition: renal impairment or grade 3 to 4 myelosuppression
doseModificationRules.text: Delay or reduce per clinical review; consider carboplatin substitution for renal impairment or cisplatin intolerance.

doseModificationRules.condition: bevacizumab-related hypertension, proteinuria, bleeding, or thromboembolism
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or discontinue bevacizumab per labeling and clinical review.

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: PLATINUM (cisplatin modeled; carboplatin is a source-listed alternative platinum per the guideline, line 774). Dose value grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 68904 (cisplatin 75 mg/m2 plus pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks). CISplatin 75 mg/m2 IV day 1 with IV hydration and nephro-/oto-/neurotoxicity precautions (DeVita line 132304 hydration; line 16606 irreversible nephro-, neuro-, ototoxicities). Mesothelioma indication for the cisplatin/pemetrexed doublet is grounded to Harrison line 82143 to 82144 and the MAPS mesothelioma trial (DeVita line 292733).

provenance.locator: line 68904 (cisplatin 75 mg/m2 plus pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks)

drugs.name: Pemetrexed
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 68904 (pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks). Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 IV day 1. REQUIRES folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation to reduce toxicity (Harrison line 82142) plus dexamethasone premedication for rash prophylaxis (standard supportive care).

provenance.locator: line 68904 (pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks, with cisplatin 75 mg/m2)

drugs.name: Bevacizumab
drugs.notes: OPTIONAL add-on (the +/- in the regimen name). Source: bevacizumab 15 mg/kg every 21 days dose grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 68586; the mesothelioma bevacizumab-plus-cisplatin/pemetrexed combination (MAPS) is grounded to DeVita line 292733 and the guideline (line 776 to 777, (Carboplatin or Cisplatin)/Pemetrexed + Bevacizumab, category 1). Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV day 1 every 21 days. Anti-VEGF: check for contraindications (bleeding, uncontrolled hypertension, recent surgery).

provenance.locator: line 68586 (bevacizumab 15 mg/kg every 21 days); MAPS mesothelioma trial line 292733 (bevacizumab added to cisplatin/pemetrexed)
